title: Role configuration (_ai/roles/<role>/role-config.yaml)
description: A role's configuration beside its role.md. Edited in the Role Editor (@T: Open Role Editor).

roleType.description: The role type (a folder of _ai/role-types/) whose configuration the role takes, e.g. its tools. Absent: the profile's defaults.

guidelines.description: The role's guideline choices, over its role type's: an aspect section (a folder of _ai/aspect_guidelines/) mapped to an option's short name, or to `remove` (nothing is sent for that section). A section without an entry inherits from the levels above (Don't add). Absent: no choices.
